title: SummerSalt Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes - Parking for 2 cars (1 in garage, 1 car on street with required hang tag) - Located in Rosemary Beach off of 30A - Fully stocked kitchen - Walking distance to the beach - Walking / biking distance to shops and restaurants - Access to the beach and all four Rosemary Beach pools (including one indoor pool). Tennis courts, a fitness center - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). SummerSalt is a Carriage House in Rosemary Beach, the main house, Sea La Vie is rented separately. Centrally located and just a couple of blocks to Rosemary's town square (with dining and shopping), SummerSalt is your new favorite beach home. You're only 1 block to the Rosemary Beach Sky Pool. Upon entering this beach retreat you'll find a large open living space, queen bed, set of twin beds, a full kitchen (no oven) and full bath. The living room has a couch and two chairs that seat four guests comfortably to watch TV. There is a 40" 4K Smart HDTV in the living area. A washer and dryer (in garage) as well as an iron and ironing board are provided. Rosemary Beach has 4 private pools, (one is heated), tennis courts, fitness center, private beach, 2 large greens overlooking the Gulf, and many boutique shops and restaurants for your enjoyment. The town of Rosemary Beach, located along the Emerald coast in Florida's panhandle, is a stunning example of new urbanism. Restaurants, coffee shop, book store, retail stores, art galleries, bank, post office, hair salon, fitness center, tennis center, 4 community pools, chapel and the beach - all in a walkable environment, accessible via a network of boardwalks and pathways create a true, livable beach community. This carriage house has everything you need for a great and relaxing vacation. The beach, plus all the dining, shopping and amenities Rosemary Beach has to offer are just steps away! ADDITIONAL DETAILS: • 2 Back Pack Beach Chairs • 1 Beach Umbrella * Sandpiper cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities ACCOMMODATIONS (sleeps 4): Studio style- Queen bed, set of twin bunk beds IMPORTAT DETAILS: ** The guest house does not have access to the private pool when rented separately from the main house. ** Please Note: The Main House, Sea La Vie Rosemary is rented separately. Give us a call if you want to reserve the main house as well. * Beach set-ups (chairs and umbrellas) are available on-site on a fee basis ** 2 Complimentary Bikes ** Sorry, no pets ** Must be 25 to rent Amenities Kitchen Coffee Maker Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Dishwasher Leisure Activities Bird watching Photography Scenic drives Sight seeing Walking Location Type Beach Near The Ocean Town Pool Spa Communal Pool Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Living Air Conditioning Ceiling Fans Linens Washer & Dryer Ironing Board Outdoor Balcony Tennis Beach Playground Heated Communal Pool Entertainment Cable TV WiFi 2 Bikes Included Smart TV 2 Beach Chairs w/ Umbrella Beach Town Beach Town -
